title: Concept: Regular expression compiled from input in python — review required
description: In python, re.compile() turns request text into a matcher. The backtracking engine explores alternatives exponentially on adversarial input, and nothing in the standard library stops it. Validation endpoints, log parsers and search filters therefore become a denial-of-service surface when the pattern is user supplied.
applicability: python services that compile patterns from parameters or stored configuration.
risk: Worker exhaustion through catastrophic backtracking; MEDIUM severity.
